targets.S3: RewardPool.stake: a new staker claims rewards accrued before staking (impact: tokens moved to the new staker)
targets.S4: LendingPool spot price: after moving the pair's reserves, a borrower borrows more than the collateral's undistorted value (impact: pool loses debt tokens, attacker ends with more value than put in)
targets.S5: LendingPool.setPair: a non-owner installs a pair and borrows the pool's debt token balance (impact: pool drained)
targets.S6: PayoutSplitter.distribute: one failing recipient makes every distribution revert, funds remain stuck (impact: permanent lock under the stated token behaviour)

demonstrates_impact_means: the test asserts a value change (balances before/after, profit, or that funds remain locked after all available actions), not merely that a call reverts
